description.value:
You can make the most of limited medical supplies. You can store up to 3 items with the healing or serum trait in your custom rig. You gain the following new mods.

  • Numbing Analgesic (medpatch or serum): In addition to its usual effects, the item reduces the value of the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Sickened] condition by 1.

  • Powerful Stimulant (medpatch or serum): In addition to its usual effects, the item reduces the value of the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Enfeebled] or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Frightened] condition by 1.

  • Protective Excretions (medpatch or serum): In addition to its usual effects, the item attempts a @Check[flat|dc:10|showDC:all] to end one persistent damage type afflicting the target with a DC of 10.

  • Restorative Boost (medpatch or serum): In addition to its usual effect, the item grants fast healing equal to half the item's level (rounded up) for 3 rounds.
